title: Aria — Real-Time Voice AI Sales Agent
tagline: Voice AI sales rep that qualifies, negotiates, and writes to a real CRM live on the call.
description: Aria runs a full B2B sales qualification call out loud in real time: answers pricing questions from a knowledge base, handles objections, negotiates, remembers context, writes to a real CRM while still talking, books a meeting, and escalates to a human with a written handoff brief when needed.
author: Aryan-Techie
